name: ag
description: Ultra-fast code search with .gitignore filtering and PCRE regex

ag.description: Ultra-fast code search with .gitignore filtering and PCRE regex
ag.usage:
ag 'TODO|FIXME' --color --group # Search for todos with colored grouped output
ag -i -w 'function' --js --ts # Case-insensitive whole-word search in JS/TS files
ag -l -0 'pattern' | xargs -0 sed -i 's/old/new/g' # Find files then batch replace
ag -A 5 -B 2 'class.*extends' --java # Show context around class definitions
ag --depth 3 'import.*react' src/ # Limit search depth and directory
ag -s 'SENSITIVE' # Search including normally ignored files
ag --stats 'function' # Show search statistics and performance metrics
ag -o '\b\w+@\w+\.\w+\b' # Extract email addresses using regex groups
ag --parallel --nofilename '^#include' *.{c,h,cpp} # Parallel search C headers
ag -Q 'literal.string.with.dots' # Literal search without regex interpretation
